summary: Backend-only review for LoL Autopicker v2.7.0 (spells vorab beim Hover, Lolalytics-Ban-Vorschläge, Hardcounter-Vorschläge, All-Ranks/30-Tage-Default + patch=30 Migration, Alt+Shift+4 close-command, Overlay-Padding). All green: 7/7 FastAPI backend tests, 61/61 autopicker pytest under Xvfb :99, 8/8 Node extension tests, live Lolalytics fetch_counters/fetch_bans verified against spec, URL/storage/selection unit behaviour verified, Tk overlay screenshots re-rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: autopicker_downloads.py now serves LoL-Autopicker-2.7.0.zip plus README.md + SHA256.txt via /api/autopicker/downloads. SHA256 of the served zip matches SHA256.txt; the archive contains README.md, Start.bat, lolpicker/lcu.py, lolpicker/lolalytics.py, lolpicker/runes.py, lolpicker/loadout_ui.py, extension/chromium/background.js (contains 'close_lolalytics') and extension/chromium/manifest.json with version 2.7.0. Path-traversal, unknown filename and disallowed extensions still return 404.

lolpicker.urls.build_url('Viego','jungle',420) => 'https://lolalytics.com/lol/viego/build/?lane=jungle&patch=30&tier=all' (patch=30 + tier=all defaults); with_default_patch adds patch=30 only when the query is missing it and keeps a user-provided patch=7 untouched.
storage.clean_config: schema=3 config with lolalytics_import.patch='7' is migrated to patch='30', while schema=4 keeps '7' — one-shot migration works as spec'd.
selection.available(session, 123, 'ban') returns False as soon as a teammate carries championPickIntent==123 — required for greying teammate-hovered champs in the ban list.

Live lolalytics.fetch_counters('Viego','jungle') returns lane='jungle', 30 rows sorted strictly ascending by winrate, each with champion_id/winrate/games. fetch_bans('jungle') returns 20 rows sorted descending by banrate with Master Yi (championId=11) at rank 0; fetch_bans('') for all lanes also returns 20 rows headed by Master Yi.

lcu/handle SELECT branch + prepare_spells/loadout_for cover hover-based spell apply (test_lcu_mock_server.test_hover_sets_spells_before_lock_in_and_marks_teammate_bans passes under 61-test pytest suite); ban_status 'teammate' flag is emitted correctly.
controller.close_browsers / Alt+Shift+4 path verified by test_controller_queue_phase.py — the suite passes end-to-end.
